description.value: Cactus Club Cafe is a well-established upscale-casual Canadian chain known for chef-driven international cuisine in stylish, energetic dining rooms. The Station Square location in Burnaby is one of several Metro Vancouver outposts offering a broad menu of cocktails, seafood, pasta, and shared plates. Takeout and delivery are available directly through the restaurant, making it a viable stop for a cyclist wanting a sit-down meal or a grab-and-go option.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: rack (6 spaces) at 68m; rack (6 spaces) at 72m; stands (4 spaces, paid) at 75m. Total: 16 spaces.
